Its meaning is: la ilaha negates everything worshiped besides Allah, while illa Allah affirms worship for Allah alone, without partner. The conditions of la ilaha illa Allah are knowledge that contradicts ignorance; certainty that contradicts doubt; sincerity that contradicts shirk (associating partners with Allah); truthfulness that contradicts lying; love that contradicts hatred; submission that contradicts shirk; acceptance that contradicts rejection; and rejecting what is worshiped besides Allah. They have been collected in these two verses of poetry:
Knowledge, certainty, sincerity and your truthfulness, with … love, submission and acceptance of it.
An eighth is added: your rejection of what … besides the true God has been treated as a god.
Also explaining the testimony that Muhammad is Allah's Messenger and its requirements: believing what he reports, obeying what he commands, avoiding what he forbids and restrains from, and worshiping Allah only according to what Allah, mighty and majestic is He, and His Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, have prescribed.

As for tawhid al-uluhiyyah (affirming Allah's sole right to worship), it is believing that Allah, glorified is He, alone deserves worship, with no partner in that. This is the meaning of la ilaha illa Allah: no one deserves worship except Allah. All acts of worship, including prayer, fasting and others, must therefore be devoted sincerely to Allah alone; none of them may be directed to anyone else.
As for tawhid al-asma wa-s-sifat (affirming Allah's names and attributes), it is believing in all the names and attributes of Allah stated in the Noble Quran or authentic hadith, and affirming them for Allah alone in the manner befitting Him, glorified is He, without tahrif (distortion), tatil (denial), takyif (specifying how they are), or tamthil (likening them to created attributes), acting upon Allah's statement: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ - اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ - لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ - وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ [Full-verse context (112:1):
Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011]

وأقسام الشرك ثلاثة: شرك أكبر، وشرك أصغر، وشرك خفي.
فالشرك الأكبر: يوجب حبوط العمل والخلود في النار لمن مات عليه، كما قال الله تعالى: {وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ} [الأنعام: 88] وقال سبحانه: {مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَنْ يَعْمُرُوا مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ شَاهِدِينَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِالْكُفْرِ أُولَئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ وَفِي النَّارِ هُمْ خَالِدُونَ} [التوبة: 17] وأن من مات عليه فلن يغفر له، والجنة عليه حرام، كما قال الله عز وجل: {إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَنْ يُشْرَكَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ} [النساء: 48] وقال سبحانه: {إِنَّهُ مَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَاهُ النَّارُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ} [المائدة: 72]

There is no dispute over this terminology, because the intended meaning is clear in both divisions.
There are three categories of shirk (associating partners with Allah): major shirk, minor shirk and hidden shirk.
Major shirk invalidates deeds and entails abiding forever in the Fire for anyone who dies upon it, as Allah Most High says: وَلَوْ أَشْرَكُوا لَحَبِطَ عَنْهُمْ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ [Full-verse context (6:88):
That is the guidance of Allāh by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allāh, then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.] [Al-Anam: 88]. He, glorified is He, says: مَا كَانَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ أَنْ يَعْمُرُوا مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ شَاهِدِينَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِالْكُفْرِ أُولَئِكَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَالُهُمْ وَفِي النَّارِ هُمْ خَالِدُونَ [Full-verse context (9:17):
It is not for the polytheists to maintain the mosques of Allāh [while] witnessing against themselves with disbelief. [For] those, their deeds have become worthless, and in the Fire they will abide eternally.] [At-Tawbah: 17]. Anyone who dies upon it will not be forgiven, and Paradise is forbidden to him, as Allah, mighty and majestic, says: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَنْ يُشْرَكَ بِهِ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَ ذَلِكَ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ [Full-verse context (4:48):
Indeed, Allāh does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills. And he who associates others with Allāh has certainly fabricated a tremendous sin.] [An-Nisa: 48]. He, glorified is He, says: إِنَّهُ مَنْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَأْوَاهُ النَّارُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ [Full-verse context (5:72):
They have certainly disbelieved who say, "Allāh is the Messiah, the son of Mary" while the Messiah has said, "O Children of Israel, worship Allāh, my Lord and your Lord." Indeed, he who associates others with Allāh - Allāh has forbidden him Paradise, and his refuge is the Fire. And there are not for the wrongdoers any helpers.] [Al-Maidah: 72].
Its forms include supplicating to the dead and idols, seeking their rescue, making vows to them, sacrificing to them, and similar acts.

وقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «من حلف بشيء دون الله فقد أشرك» رواه الإمام أحمد بإسناد صحيح، عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه، ورواه أبو داود، والترمذي بإسناد صحيح، من حديث ابن عمر رضي الله عنهما، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال: «من حلف بغير الله فقد كفر أو أشرك» وقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لا تقولوا: ما شاء الله وشاء فلان، ولكن قولوا: ما شاء الله ثم شاء فلان» أخرجه أبو داود بإسناد صحيح، عن حذيفة بن اليمان رضي الله عنه.

the Book or Sunnah (prophetic way) calls shirk (associating partners with Allah), but which is not of the category of major shirk, such as riya (showing off) in some deeds, swearing by other than Allah, saying 'What Allah wills and so-and-so wills,' and similar things. The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'What I fear most for you is minor shirk.' Asked about it, he said: 'Showing off.' Imam Ahmad, At-Tabarani and Al-Bayhaqi narrated it from Mahmud ibn Labid al-Ansari, may Allah be pleased with him, with a good chain. At-Tabarani also narrated it with good chains from Mahmud ibn Labid, from Rafi ibn Khadij, from the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.
He, peace and blessings be upon him, also said: 'Whoever swears by anything besides Allah has committed shirk.' Imam Ahmad narrated it with an authentic chain from Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him. Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi narrated with an authentic chain from Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, that the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Whoever swears by other than Allah has disbelieved or committed shirk.' He, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Do not say, What Allah wills and so-and-so wills; rather say, What Allah wills, then so-and-so wills.' Abu Dawud recorded it with an authentic chain from Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman, may Allah be pleased with him.

وهذا النوع لا يوجب الردة، ولا يوجب الخلود في النار، ولكنه ينافي كمال التوحيد الواجب.
أما النوع الثالث: وهو الشرك الخفي، فدليله قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «ألا أخبركم بما هو أخوف عليكم عندي من المسيح الدجال؟ قالوا: بلى يا رسول الله، قال: الشرك الخفي، يقوم الرجل فيصلي فيزين صلاته لما يرى من نظر الرجل إليه» رواه الإمام أحمد في مسنده، عن أبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه.
ويجوز أن يقسم الشرك إلى نوعين فقط: أكبر وأصغر، أما الشرك الخفي فإنه يعمهما.
فيقع في الأكبر، كشرك المنافقين؛ لأنهم يخفون عقائدهم الباطلة، ويتظاهرون بالإسلام رياء، وخوفا على أنفسهم.
ويكون في الشرك الأصغر، كالرياء، كما في حديث محمود بن لبيد الأنصاري المتقدم، وحديث أبي سعيد المذكور. والله ولي التوفيق.
items.tr:
This category does not entail apostasy or eternal residence in the Fire, but contradicts the obligatory completeness of tawhid (affirming Allah's oneness).
The third category, hidden shirk (associating partners with Allah), is evidenced by the Prophet's saying, peace and blessings be upon him: 'Shall I tell you what I fear for you more than Al-Masih ad-Dajjal (the false messiah)?' They said: 'Yes, Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Hidden shirk: a man stands to pray and beautifies his prayer because he sees another man watching him.' Imam Ahmad narrated it in his Musnad from Abu Said al-Khudri, may Allah be pleased with him.
Shirk may be divided into only two categories, major and minor, while hidden shirk encompasses both.
It occurs in major shirk, as in the hypocrisy of those who conceal false beliefs while outwardly professing Islam to show off and protect themselves.
It also occurs in minor shirk, such as showing off, as in the preceding hadith of Mahmud ibn Labid al-Ansari and the hadith of Abu Said mentioned above. Allah is the Granter of success.

الدرس الخامس: الإحسان ركن الإحسان، وهو: أن تعبد الله كأنك تراه، فإن لم تكن تراه فإنه يراك.

[الدرس السادس شروط الصلاة]
الدرس السادس: شروط الصلاة شروط الصلاة، وهي تسعة:
الإسلام، والعقل، والتمييز، ورفع الحدث، وإزالة النجاسة، وستر العورة، ودخول الوقت، واستقبال القبلة، والنية.
items.tr:
[Lesson five: Ihsan]
Lesson five: Ihsan (excellence in worship). Its pillar is worshiping Allah as though you see Him; if you do not see Him, He sees you.

[Lesson six: Conditions of salah]
Lesson six: Conditions of salah (prayer). They are nine:
Islam, sanity, discernment, removing hadath (ritual impurity), removing najasah (physical impurity), covering the awrah (body parts that must be covered), the prayer time beginning, facing the qiblah (direction of prayer), and niyyah (intention).

items.ar:
[الدرس السابع أركان الصلاة]
الدرس السابع: أركان الصلاة أركان الصلاة، وهي أربعة عشر:
القيام مع القدرة، وتكبيرة الإحرام، وقراءة الفاتحة، والركوع، والاعتدال بعد الركوع، والسجود على الأعضاء السبعة، والرفع منه، والجلسة بين السجدتين، والطمأنينة في جميع الأفعال، والترتيب بين الأركان، والتشهد الأخير، والجلوس له، والصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، والتسليمتان.

items.tr:
[Lesson seven: The pillars of salah]
Lesson seven: The pillars of salah (prayer). They are fourteen:
Standing when able, takbirat al-ihram (the opening declaration of Allah's greatness), reciting Al-Fatihah, bowing, standing upright after bowing, prostrating on the seven body parts, rising from prostration, sitting between the two prostrations, calm stillness in all acts, following the order of the pillars, the final tashahhud (seated testimony), sitting for it, invoking blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and the two taslims (closing greetings of peace).

[Lesson eight: The obligations of salah]
Lesson eight: The obligations of salah. They are eight:
All takbirs (declarations of Allah's greatness) except the opening takbir; saying 'Allah hears whoever praises Him' for the imam and person praying alone; saying 'Our Lord, all praise

[Lesson nine: Explaining tashahhud]
Lesson nine: Explaining tashahhud. It is to say:
All greetings of reverence, prayers and good things belong to Allah. Peace be upon you, Prophet, and Allah's mercy and blessings. Peace be upon us and Allah's righteous servants. I bear witness that none is worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.
Then invoke blessings and benediction upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, saying: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's family as You blessed Ibrahim and Ibrahim's family. Then, in the final tashahhud (seated testimony), seek refuge in Allah from the punishment of Jahannam (Hell), the punishment of the grave, the trials of life and death and the trial of Al-Masih ad-Dajjal (the false messiah). Then choose whatever dua (supplication) you wish, especially transmitted supplications, including:
O Allah, help me remember You, thank You and worship You well. O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins except You. Grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me. You are Al-Ghafur (the All-Forgiving), Ar-Rahim (the Especially Merciful).
In the first tashahhud, rise after the two testimonies of faith to the third rakah (unit of prayer) in Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha. Invoking blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, is better because of the general hadiths on this; then rise to the third rakah.

items.ar:
[الدرس العاشر سنن الصلاة]
الدرس العاشر: سنن الصلاة سنن الصلاة، ومنها:
1 - الاستفتاح.
2 - جعل كف اليد اليمنى على اليسرى فوق الصدر حين القيام، قبل الركوع وبعده.
3 - رفع اليدين مضمومتي الأصابع ممدودة حذو المنكبين أو الأذنين عند التكبير الأول، وعند الركوع، والرفع منه، وعند القيام من التشهد الأول إلى الثالثة.
4 - ما زاد عن واحدة في تسبيح الركوع والسجود.
5 - ما زاد على قول: (ربنا ولك الحمد) بعد القيام من الركوع، وما زاد عن واحدة في الدعاء بالمغفرة بين السجدتين.
6 - جعل الرأس حيال الظهر في الركوع.
7 - مجافاة العضدين عن الجنبين، والبطن عن الفخذين، والفخذين عن الساقين في السجود.
8 - رفع الذراعين عن الأرض حين السجود.
items.tr:
[Lesson ten: Recommended practices of salah]
Lesson ten: Recommended practices of salah (prayer), including:
1 - The opening supplication.
2 - Placing the right palm over the left on the chest while standing, before and after bowing.
3 - Raising the hands with fingers together and extended to shoulder or ear level at the first takbir (Allah is greatest), when bowing, rising from bowing, and rising from the first tashahhud (seated testimony) to the third rakah (unit of prayer).
4 - Glorifying Allah more than once in bowing and prostration.
5 - Saying more than 'Our Lord, all praise belongs to You' after rising from bowing, and asking forgiveness more than once between the two prostrations.
6 - Keeping the head level with the back while bowing.
7 - Keeping the upper arms away from the sides, the abdomen from the thighs and the thighs from the lower legs in prostration.
8 - Raising the forearms off the ground in prostration.

الدرس الحادي عشر: مبطلات الصلاة مبطلات الصلاة، وهي ثمانية:

items.tr:
Saying more than 'Our Lord, all praise belongs to You' after rising from bowing is recommended for the imam, follower and person praying alone. Another is placing the hands on the knees with fingers spread while bowing.

[Lesson eleven: What invalidates salah]
Lesson eleven: What invalidates salah (prayer). They are eight:
1 - Deliberate speech while remembering and knowing the ruling. Someone forgetful or unaware of the ruling does not invalidate his prayer by this.
2 - Laughing.
3 - Eating.
4 - Drinking.
5 - Exposure of the awrah (body parts that must be covered).
6 - Turning substantially away from the qiblah (direction of prayer).
7 - Excessive consecutive fidgeting in prayer.
8 - Invalidation of taharah (ritual purification).

items.ar:
[الدرس الثاني عشر شروط الوضوء]
الدرس الثاني عشر: شروط الوضوء شروط الوضوء، وهي عشرة:
الإسلام، والعقل، والتمييز، والنية، واستصحاب حكمها بأن لا ينوي قطعها حتى تتم طهارته، وانقطاع موجب الوضوء، واستنجاء أو استجمار قبله، وطهورية ماءه وإباحته، وإزالة ما يمنع وصوله إلى البشرة، ودخول وقت الصلاة في حق من حدثه دائم.

[الدرس الثالث عشر فروض الوضوء]
الدرس الثالث عشر: فروض الوضوء فروض الوضوء، وهي ستة:
غسل الوجه ومنه المضمضة والاستنشاق، وغسل اليدين مع المرفقين، ومسح جميع الرأس ومنه الأذنان، وغسل الرجلين مع الكعبين، والترتيب، والموالاة.
items.tr:
[Lesson twelve: Conditions of wudu]
Lesson twelve: Conditions of wudu (ablution). They are ten:
Islam, sanity, discernment, niyyah (intention), maintaining its effect by not intending to discontinue it until purification is complete, cessation of the cause requiring ablution, istinja (cleaning with water) or istijmar (cleaning with stones) beforehand, water that purifies and is lawful to use, removing anything preventing water from reaching the skin, and the prayer time beginning for someone with continuous ritual impurity.

[Lesson thirteen: Obligatory components of wudu]
Lesson thirteen: Obligatory components of wudu. They are six:
Washing the face, including rinsing the mouth and drawing water into the nose; washing the arms including the elbows; wiping the entire head, including the ears; washing the feet including the ankles; following the order; and continuity.

items.ar:
ويستحب تكرار غسل الوجه، واليدين، والرجلين ثلاث مرات، وهكذا المضمضة، والاستنشاق، والفرض من ذلك مرة واحدة، أما مسح الرأس فلا يستحب تكراره كما دلت على ذلك الأحاديث الصحيحة.

[الدرس الرابع عشر نواقض الوضوء]
الدرس الرابع عشر: نواقض الوضوء نواقض الوضوء، وهي ستة:
الخارج من السبيلين، والخارج الفاحش النجس من الجسد، وزوال العقل بنوم أو غيره، ومس الفرج باليد قبلا كان أو دبرا من غير حائل، وأكل لحم الإبل، والردة عن الإسلام، أعاذنا الله والمسلمين من ذلك.
تنبيه هام: أما غسل الميت: فالصحيح أنه لا ينقض الوضوء، وهو قول أكثر أهل العلم؛ لعدم الدليل على ذلك، لكن لو أصابت يد الغاسل فرج الميت من غير حائل وجب عليه الوضوء.
items.tr:
Washing the face, arms and feet three times is recommended, as are rinsing the mouth and drawing water into the nose three times. Once is obligatory. Repeating the wiping of the head is not recommended, as authentic hadiths indicate.

[Lesson fourteen: Invalidators of wudu]
Lesson fourteen: Invalidators of wudu (ablution). They are six:
Discharge from either private passage; a large amount of impure discharge from the body; loss of awareness through sleep or otherwise; directly touching the private part, front or back, with the hand without a barrier; eating camel meat; and apostasy from Islam. May Allah protect us and Muslims from that.
Important note: Washing the deceased does not invalidate ablution according to the correct view, held by most scholars, because there is no evidence for that. However, if the washer's hand touches the deceased's private part without a barrier, ablution becomes obligatory.

items.ar:

أما قول الله سبحانه في آيتي النساء، والمائدة: {أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ} [النساء: 43] فالمراد به: الجماع، في الأصح من قولي العلماء، وهو قول ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما، وجماعة من السلف والخلف. والله ولي التوفيق.

الدرس الخامس عشر: التحلي بالأخلاق المشروعة لكل مسلم التحلي بالأخلاق المشروعة لكل مسلم، ومنها: الصدق، والأمانة، والعفاف، والحياء، والشجاعة، والكرم، والوفاء، والنزاهة عن كل ما حرم الله، وحسن
items.tr:
He must touch the deceased person's private parts only through a barrier. Likewise, touching a woman does not invalidate wudu (ablution) at all, whether with desire or without it, according to the more correct of the scholars' two opinions, unless something is discharged from him. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, kissed one of his wives, then prayed without performing wudu.
As for Allah's statement in the verses of An-Nisa and Al-Maidah: أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ [Full-verse context (4:43):
O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying[187] or in a state of janābah,[188] except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women [i.e., had sexual intercourse] and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it]. Indeed, Allāh is ever Pardoning[189] and Forgiving.
[187] The use of intoxicants was later prohibited completely. See 5:90-91.
[188] Literally, "distance." The state of one under obligation to perform ghusl (a complete bath) due to having had sexual intercourse or ejaculation.
[189] Literally, able to erase and remove sins completely, leaving no trace of them in the record of deeds.] [An-Nisa: 43], it means sexual intercourse, according to the more correct of the scholars' two opinions. This is the opinion of Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both, and a group of earlier and later scholars. Allah is the One Who grants success.

Lesson fifteen: Adopting the character prescribed for every Muslim. Adopting the character prescribed for every Muslim, including truthfulness, trustworthiness, chastity, modesty, courage, generosity, faithfulness, and keeping oneself free of everything Allah has forbidden, and

[الدرس السادس عشر التأدب بالآداب الإسلامية]
الدرس السادس عشر: التأدب بالآداب الإسلامية التأدب بالآداب الإسلامية، ومنها:
السلام، والبشاشة، والأكل باليمين والشرب بها، والتسمية عند الابتداء، والحمد عند الفراغ، والحمد بعد العطاس، وتشميت العاطس إذا حمد الله، وعيادة المريض، واتباع الجنائز للصلاة والدفن، والآداب الشرعية عند دخول المسجد، أو المنزل والخروج منهما، وعند السفر، ومع الوالدين، والأقارب والجيران، والكبار والصغار والتهنئة بالمولود، والتبريك بالزواج، والتعزية في المصاب، وغير ذلك من الآداب الإسلامية في اللبس والخلع والانتعال.

treatment of neighbors, helping those in need as much as one can, and other qualities whose prescription is indicated by the Book or Sunnah (prophetic way).

[Lesson sixteen: Observing Islamic manners]
Lesson sixteen: Observing Islamic manners, including:
Salam (the greeting of peace), a cheerful face, eating and drinking with the right hand, mentioning Allah's name when beginning, praising Him when finished, praising Him after sneezing, praying for a sneezer who praises Allah, visiting the sick, following funerals for prayer and burial, prescribed manners when entering and leaving the mosque or home, traveling, and dealing with parents, relatives, neighbors, the old and young; offering congratulations on a newborn, praying for blessing upon a marriage, offering condolences for a loss, and other Islamic manners in putting on clothing, taking it off and putting on shoes.

items.ar:
[الدرس السابع عشر التحذير من الشرك وأنواع المعاصي]
الدرس السابع عشر: التحذير من الشرك وأنواع المعاصي الحذر والتحذير من الشرك وأنواع المعاصي، ومنها: السبع الموبقات (المهلكات) وهي: الشرك بالله، والسحر، وقتل النفس التي حَرم الله إلا بالحق، وأكل الربا، وأكل مال اليتيم، والتولي يوم الزحف، وقذف المحصنات الغافلات المؤمنات.
ومنها: عقوق الوالدين، وقطيعة الرحم، وشهادة الزور، والأيمان الكاذبة، وإيذاء الجار، وظلم الناس في الدماء، والأموال، والأعراض، وشرب المسكر، ولعب القمار- وهو: الميسر- والغيبة، والنميمة، وغير ذلك مما نهى الله عز وجل عنه، أو رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم.
items.tr:
[Lesson seventeen: Warning against shirk and kinds of sins]
Lesson seventeen: Warning against shirk (associating partners with Allah) and kinds of sins. Avoid and warn against shirk and kinds of sins, including the seven destructive sins: associating partners with Allah, sihr (magic), killing a person whose life Allah has made inviolable except with lawful right, consuming riba (usury), consuming an orphan's wealth, fleeing on the day of battle, and accusing chaste, unsuspecting believing women of adultery.
Other sins include undutifulness toward parents, severing ties of kinship, false testimony, false oaths, harming a neighbor, wronging people regarding their lives, wealth and honor, drinking intoxicants, gambling, which is maysir (games of chance), ghibah (backbiting), namimah (malicious tale-bearing), and everything else forbidden by Allah, mighty and majestic is He, or His Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him.

items.ar:
[الدرس الثامن عشر تجهيز الميت والصلاة عليه ودفنه]
[أولا تلقين المحتضر]
الدرس الثامن عشر: تجهيز الميت والصلاة عليه ودفنه وإليك تفصيل ذلك:
أولا: يشرع تلقين المحتضر: (لا إله إلا الله) ؛ لقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لقنوا موتاكم: لا إله إلا الله» رواه مسلم في صحيحه، والمراد بالموتى في هذا الحديث: المحتضرون، وهم من ظهرت عليهم أمارات الموت.

[ثانيا إذا تيقن موته أغمضت عيناه وشد لحياه]
ثانيا: إذا تيقن موته أغمضت عيناه وشد لحياه؛ لورود السنة بذلك.

[ثالثا يجب تغسيل الميت المسلم إلا أن يكون شهيدا مات في المعركة]
ثالثا: يجب تغسيل الميت المسلم، إلا أن يكون شهيدا مات في المعركة فإنه لا يغسل ولا يصلى عليه، بل يدفن في ثيابه؛ لأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لم يغسل قتلى أحد ولم يصل عليهم.

[رابعا صفة غسل الميت]
أنه تستر عورته، ثم يرفع قليلا ويعصر بطنه عصرا
items.tr:
[Lesson eighteen: Preparing, praying over and burying the deceased]
[First: Prompting the dying person]
Lesson eighteen: Preparing, praying over and burying the deceased. The details follow:
First: It is prescribed to prompt the dying person to say la ilaha illa Allah (none is worthy of worship except Allah), because the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Prompt your dying ones to say la ilaha illa Allah.' Muslim narrated it in his Sahih. The dead referred to in this hadith are the dying: those showing signs of death.

[Second: Once death is certain, close the eyes and bind the jaws]
Second: Once death is certain, close the eyes and bind the jaws, because this is transmitted in the Sunnah (prophetic way).

[Third: A deceased Muslim must be washed, except a martyr who died in battle]
Third: A deceased Muslim must be washed, except a martyr who died in battle. He is neither washed nor prayed over, but buried in his clothes, because the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, neither washed nor prayed over those killed at Uhud.

[Fourth: How to wash the deceased]
Cover the awrah (body parts that must be covered), raise the body slightly and press the abdomen

items.ar:
رفيقا، ثم يلف الغاسل على يده خرقة أو نحوها فينجيه بها، ثم يوضئه وضوء الصلاة، ثم يغسل رأسه ولحيته بماء وسدر أو نحوه، ثم يغسل شقه الأيمن، ثم الأيسر، ثم يغسله كذلك مرة ثانية وثالثة، يمر في كل مرة يده على بطنه، فإن خرج منه شيء غسله، وسد المحل بقطن أو نحوه، فإن لم يستمسك فبطين حر، أو بوسائل الطب الحديثة؛ كاللزق ونحوه.
ويعيد وضوءه، وإن لم ينق بثلاث زِيد إلى خمس، أو إلى سبع، ثم ينشفه بثوب، ويجعل الطيب في مغابنه، ومواضع سجوده، وإن طيبه كله كان حسنا، ويجمر أكفانه بالبخور، وإن كان شاربه أو أظفاره طويلة أخذ منها، وإن ترك ذلك فلا حرج، ولا يسرح شعره، ولا يحلق عانته، ولا يختنه؛ لعدم الدليل على ذلك، والمرأة يضفر شعرها ثلاثة قرون، ويسدل من ورائها.

[خامسا تكفين الميت]
الأفضل أن يكفن الرجل في ثلاثة أثواب بيض ليس فيها قميص ولا عمامة، كما فعل بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، يدرج فيها
items.tr:
gently. The washer then wraps a cloth or something similar around his hand and cleans the private parts with it, then performs wudu (ablution) for the deceased as for salah (prayer). Wash the head and beard with water and sidr (lote leaves) or something similar, then the right side and then the left. Repeat this a second and third time, passing the hand over the abdomen each time. If anything comes out, wash it and plug the opening with cotton or something similar. If it does not stay in place, use pure clay or modern medical means, such as adhesive or similar materials.
Repeat the ablution. If three washes do not cleanse the body, increase to five or seven. Dry it with a cloth and apply perfume to the folds of the body and the points of prostration. Perfuming the entire body is good. Fumigate the shrouds with incense. If the mustache or nails are long, trim them; leaving them is unobjectionable. Do not comb the hair, shave pubic hair or circumcise, because there is no evidence for that. Braid a woman's hair into three plaits and let them hang behind her.

[Fifth: Shrouding the deceased]
It is preferable to shroud a man in three white cloths without a shirt or turban, as was done for the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, wrapping him in them

items.ar:
إدراجا، وإن كفن في قميص وإزار ولفافة فلا بأس.
والمرأة تكفن في خمسة أثواب: درع، وخمار، وإزار، ولفافتين. ويكفن الصبي في ثوب واحد إلى ثلاثة أثواب، وتكفن الصغيرة في قميص ولفافتين.
والواجب في حق الجميع ثوب واحد يستر جميع الميت، لكن إذا كان الميت محرما فإنه يغسل بماء وسدر، ويكفن في إزاره وردائه أو في غيرهما، ولا يغطى رأسه ولا وجهه، ولا يطيب؛ لأنه يبعث يوم القيامة ملبيا، كما صح بذلك الحديث عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وإن كان المحرم امرأة كفنت كغيرها، ولكن لا تطيب، ولا يغطى وجهها بنقاب، ولا يداها بقفازين، ولكن يغطى وجهها ويداها بالكفن الذي كفنت فيه، كما تقدم بيان صفة تكفين المرأة.

[سادسا أحق الناس بغسله والصلاة عليه ودفنه]
سادسا: أحق الناس بغسله والصلاة عليه ودفنه: وصيه في ذلك، ثم الأب، ثم الجد، ثم الأقرب فالأقرب من العصبات في حق الرجل.
والأولى بغسل المرأة: وصيتها، ثم الأم، ثم
items.tr:
fully. Shrouding him in a shirt, lower wrap and outer sheet is unobjectionable.
A woman is shrouded in five garments: a dress, head covering, lower wrap and two outer sheets. A boy is shrouded in one to three cloths, and a young girl in a shirt and two outer sheets.
What is obligatory for all is one cloth covering the entire body. If the deceased was in ihram (the consecrated state), wash him with water and sidr (lote leaves), shroud him in his lower and upper wraps or other cloths, do not cover his head or face, and do not perfume him, because he will be raised on the Day of Resurrection reciting the talbiyah (pilgrimage response), as authentically reported from Allah's Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him. A woman who was in ihram is shrouded like other women, but without perfume, a niqab (face veil) or gloves. Cover her face and hands with her shroud, as explained above regarding shrouding women.

[Sixth: Those with the greatest right to wash, pray over and bury the deceased]
Sixth: For a man, the greatest right belongs to the person he designated for that, then his father, grandfather, and nearest male agnatic relatives in order.
Those with the greatest right to wash a woman are the woman she designated, then her mother, then

items.ar:
الجدة، ثم الأقرب فالأقرب من نسائها، وللزوجين أن يغسل أحدهما الآخر؛ لأن الصديق رضي الله عنه غسلته زوجته، ولأن عليا رضي الله عنه غسل زوجته فاطمة رضي الله عنها.

[سابعا صفة الصلاة على الميت]
يكبر أربعا، ويقرأ بعد الأولى: الفاتحة، وإن قرأ معها سورة قصيرة أو آية أو آيتين فحسن؛ للحديث الصحيح الوارد في ذلك عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما، ثم يكبر الثانية ويصلي على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كصلاته في التشهد، ثم يكبر الثالثة، ويقول: (اللهم اغفر لِحينا وميتِنا، وشاهدنا وغائبنا، وصغيرنا وكبيرنا، وذَكَرِنا وأنثانَا، اللهم من أحيَيتَهُ منا فأحيه على الإسلام، ومن توفيته منا فَتَوَفهُ على الإيمان، اللهَم اغفر له، وارحمه، وعافه، واعف عنه، وأكرِم نُزُلَه، وَوَسع مُدخَلَه، واغسله بالماء والثلج وِالبرد، ونقه من الخطايا كما ينقى الثوب الأبيض من الدَنس، وأبدلهُ دارا خيرا من داره، وأهلا خيرا من أهله، وأدخله الجنة، وأعذه من عذاب
items.tr:
her grandmother, then her nearest female relatives in order. Either spouse may wash the other, because As-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, was washed by his wife, and Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, washed his wife Fatimah, may Allah be pleased with her.

[Seventh: How to perform the funeral prayer]
Say four takbirs (declarations of Allah's greatness). After the first, recite Al-Fatihah. Adding a short surah or one or two ayat (verses) is good, because of the authentic hadith reported from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with them both. Then say the second takbir and invoke blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, as in tashahhud (the seated testimony). Then say the third takbir and say: O Allah, forgive our living and dead, those present and absent, our young and old, our males and females. O Allah, whoever among us You keep alive, keep him upon Islam; whoever You take in death, take him upon iman (faith). O Allah, forgive him, have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him. Honor his reception, widen his entrance, wash him with water, snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. Replace his home with a better home and his family with a better family. Admit him to Paradise and protect him from the punishment of

items.ar:
القبر، وعذاب النار، وافسح له في قبره، ونور له فيه، اللهم لا تَحرمنَا أجره ولا تُضِلنا بعده) ، ثم يكبر الرابعة، ويسلم تسليمة واحدة عن يمينه.
ويستحب أن يرفع يديه مع كل تكبيرة، وإذا كان الميت امرأة يقال: (اللهم اغفر لها. .) إلخ، وإذا كانت الجنائز اثنتين يقال: (اللهم اغفر لهما. . .) الخ، وإن كانت الجنائز أكثر من ذلك قال: (اللهم اغفر لهم. .) الخ، أما إذا كان فرطا فيقال بدل الدعاء له بالمغفرة: (اللهم اجعله فرطا وذُخْرَا لوالديه، وشفيعاَ مُجَابا، اللهم ثقل به موازينهما، وأعظم به أجورهما، وألحقه بصالح سلف المؤمنين، واجعله في كفالة إبراهيم عليه الصلاة والسلام، وَقِهِ برحمتك عذاب الجحيم) .
والسنة أن يقف الإمام حذاء رأس الرجل، ووسط المرأة، وأن يكون الرجل مما يلي الإمام إذا اجتمعت الجنائز، والمرأة مما يلي القبلة، وإن كان معهم أطفال قدم الصبي على المرأة، ثم المرأة، ثم الطفلة، ويكون رأس الصبي حيال رأس الرجل، ووسط المرأة حيال
items.tr:
the grave and the Fire. Make his grave spacious and illuminate it for him. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward or lead us astray after him. Then say the fourth takbir (Allah is greatest) and give one taslim (closing greeting of peace) to the right.
Raising the hands with every takbir is recommended. For a deceased woman, say 'O Allah, forgive her …' and so forth. For two deceased people, say 'O Allah, forgive them both …'; for more, say 'O Allah, forgive them …' If the deceased is a child, replace the supplication for forgiveness with: O Allah, make him a forerunner and treasure for his parents and an intercessor whose intercession is accepted. O Allah, make their scales heavy through him and magnify their rewards through him. Join him with the righteous predecessors among the believers, place him in Ibrahim's care, peace and blessings be upon him, and protect him by Your mercy from the punishment of the blazing Fire.
The Sunnah (prophetic way) is for the imam to stand level with a man's head and a woman's middle. If several deceased people are present, place the man nearest the imam and the woman nearest the qiblah (direction of prayer). If children are present, place the boy before the woman, then the woman, then the girl. The boy's head should be level with the man's head, and the woman's middle level with

items.ar:
رأس الرجل، وهكذا الطفلة يكون رأسها حيال رأس المرأة، ويكون وسطها حيال رأس الرجل، ويكون المصلون جميعا خلف الإمام، إلا أن يكون واحدا لم يجد مكانا خلف الإمام فإنه يقف عن يمينه.

[ثامنا صفة دفن الميت]
المشروع تعميق القبر إلى وسط الرجل، وأن يكون فيه لحد من جهة القبلة، وأن يوضع الميت في اللحد على جانبه الأيمن، وتحل عقد الكفن، ولا تنزع بل تترك، ولا يكشف وجهه سواء كان الميت رجلا أو امرأة، ثم ينصب عليه اللَبِن، ويطين حتى يثبت ويقيه التراب، فإن لم يتيسر اللَبِن فبغير ذلك من ألواح، أو أحجار، أو خشب يقيه التراب، ثم يهال عليه التراب، ويستحب أن يقال عند ذلك: (باسم الله، وعلى ملة رسول الله) ، ويرفع القبر قدر شبر، ويوضع عليه حصباء إن تيسر ذلك، ويرش بالماء.
ويشرع للمشيعين أن يقفوا عند القبر ويدعوا للميت؛ لأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا فرغ من دفن الميت وقف عليه،
items.tr:
the man's head. Likewise, the girl's head should be level with the woman's head and her middle level with the man's head. All those praying stand behind the imam, except a single person who finds no place behind him; he stands on his right.

[Eighth: How to bury the deceased]
The prescribed practice is to dig the grave to a man's waist height and make a lahd (side niche) toward the qiblah (direction of prayer). Place the deceased in the niche on the right side. Untie the shroud's knots but leave them in place rather than removing them. Do not uncover the face, whether the deceased is a man or woman. Set unbaked bricks over the niche and seal them with clay so they remain firm and keep earth off the body. If bricks are unavailable, use boards, stones or wood that keep earth off it. Then heap earth over it. It is recommended to say: 'In Allah's name and upon the religion of Allah's Messenger.' Raise the grave by a handspan, put pebbles on it if available and sprinkle it with water.
It is prescribed for those accompanying the funeral to stand by the grave and supplicate for the deceased, because when the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, finished burying someone, he stood by the grave

items.ar:
وقال: «استغفروا لأخيكم، واسألوا له التثبيت، فإنه الآن يسأَل» .

[تاسعا ويشرع لمن لم يُصَل عليه أن يصلي عليه بعد الدفن]
تاسعا: ويشرع لمن لم يُصَل عليه أن يصلي عليه بعد الدفن؛ لأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فعل ذلك، على أن يكون ذلك في حدود شهر فأقل، فإن كانت المدة أكثر من ذلك لم تشرع الصلاة على القبر؛ لأنه لم ينقل عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه صلى على قبر بعد شهر من دفن الميت.

[عاشرا لا يجوز لأهل الميت أن يصنعوا طعاما للناس]
عاشرا: لا يجوز لأهل الميت أن يصنعوا طعاما للناس؛ لقول جرير بن عبد الله البجلي الصحابي الجليل رضي الله عنه: (كنا نعد الاجتماع إلى أهل الميت وصنعة الطعام بعد الدفن من النياحة) رواه الإمام أحمد بسند حسن، أما صنع الطعام لهم، أو لضيوفهم فلا بأس، ويشرع لأقاربه وجيرانه أن يصنعوا لهم الطعام؛ لأن النبي-صلى الله عليه وسلم لما جاءه الخبر بموت جعفر بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه في الشام أمر أهله أن يصنعوا طعاما لأهل جعفر، وقال: «إنه أتاهم ما يشغلهم» .
ولا حرج على أهل الميت أن يدعوا جيرانهم، أو
items.tr:
and said: 'Seek forgiveness for your brother and ask for his steadfastness, for he is now being questioned.'

[Ninth: Those who did not pray over him may do so after burial]
Ninth: It is prescribed for those who did not pray over him to do so after burial, because the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, did so, provided it is within one month or less. Beyond that, prayer over the grave is not prescribed, because no report states that the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, prayed over a grave more than a month after burial.

[Tenth: The deceased's family must not prepare food for people]
Tenth: The deceased's family must not prepare food for people, because the noble Companion Jarir ibn Abdullah al-Bajali, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'We counted gathering at the deceased's family's home and preparing food after burial as wailing.' Imam Ahmad narrated it with a good chain. Preparing food for themselves or their guests is unobjectionable. Relatives and neighbors should prepare food for them, because when the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, heard of Jafar ibn Abi Talib's death in Ash-Sham, may Allah be pleased with him, he instructed his family to prepare food for Jafar's family, saying: 'Something has come to them that occupies them.'
The deceased's family may invite their neighbors or

items.ar:
غيرهم للأكل من الطعام المهْدَى إليهم، وليس لذلك وقت محدود فبما نعلم من الشرع.

[حادي عشر لا يجوز للمرأة الإحداد على ميت أكثر من ثلاثة أيام إلا على زوجها أو تكون حاملا]
حادي عشر: لا يجوز للمرأة الإحداد على ميت أكثر من ثلاثة أيام إلا على زوجها فإنه يجب عليها أن تحد عليه أربعة أشهر وعشرا، إلا أن تكون حاملا فعلى وضع الحمل؛ لثبوت السنة الصحيحة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بذلك.
أما الرجل فلا يجوز له أن يحد على أحد من الأقارب أو غيرهم.

[ثاني عشر يشرع للرجال زيارة القبور بين وقت وآخر للدعاء لهم والترحم عليهم وتذكر الموت وما بعده]
ثاني عشر: يشرع للرجال زيارة القبور بين وقت وآخر للدعاء لهم، والترحم عليهم، وتذكر الموت وما بعده؛ لقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «زوروا القبور، فإنها تذكركم الآخرة» خرجه الإمام مسلم في صحيحه، وكان صلى الله عليه وسلم يعلم أصحابه إذا زاروا القبور أن يقولوا: «السلام عليكم أهل الديار من المؤمنين والمسلمين، وإنا إن شاء الله بكم لاحقون، نسأل الله لنا ولكم العافية، يرحم الله المتقدمين منا والمستأخرين» أما النساء فليس لهن زيارة القبور؛ لأن الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم
items.tr:
others to eat the food given to them. To our knowledge, the Sharia sets no fixed time for that.

[Eleventh: A woman must not observe mourning for more than three days except for her husband, or if pregnant]
Eleventh: A woman must not observe mourning for a deceased person for more than three days except for her husband. She must mourn him for four months and ten days, unless pregnant, in which case until delivery, because authentic Sunnah (prophetic practice) establishes this.
A man must not observe such mourning for any relative or anyone else.

[Twelfth: Men should visit graves from time to time to supplicate for the deceased, ask mercy for them and remember death and what follows it]
Twelfth: Men should visit graves from time to time to supplicate for the deceased, ask mercy for them and remember death and what follows it, because the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'Visit graves, for they remind you of the Hereafter.' Imam Muslim recorded it in his Sahih. He, peace and blessings be upon him, taught his Companions to say when visiting graves: 'Peace be upon you, inhabitants of these dwellings among the believers and Muslims. If Allah wills, we will join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and you. May Allah have mercy upon those of us who have gone ahead and those who come later.' Women may not visit graves, because the Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him,

items.ar:
لعن زائرات القبور، ولأنهن يخشى من زيارتهن الفتنة وقلة الصبر، وهكذا لا يجوز لهن اتباع الجنائز إلى المقبرة؛ لأن الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم نهاهن عن ذلك، أما الصلاة على الميت في المسجد، أو في المصلى فهي مشروعة للرجال وللنساء جميعا.
هذا آخر ما تيسر جمعه.
وصلى الله وسلم على نبينا محمد، وآله وصحبه.
items.tr:
cursed women who visit graves, and because their visits may lead to fitnah (temptation or trial) and insufficient patience. They likewise must not follow funerals to the cemetery, because the Messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, forbade them to do so. Praying over the deceased in the mosque or prayer ground is prescribed for both men and women.
This concludes what could be collected.
May Allah bless and grant peace to our Prophet Muhammad, his family and Companions.
Salah (prayer)

items.tr: First: it is prescribed to prompt the dying person with: (La ilaha illa Allah) [There is no god but Allah]

items.ar: ثانيا: إذا تيقن موته أغمضت عيناه وشد لحياه
items.tr: Second: when his death is certain, his eyes are closed and his jaws are tied up

items.ar: ثالثا: يجب تغسيل الميت المسلم، إلا أن يكون شهيدا مات في المعركة فإنه لا يغسل ولا يصلى عليه، بل يدفن في ثيابه
items.tr: Third: washing the dead Muslim is obligatory, unless he is a shahid (martyr) who died in battle, for he is not washed and the funeral prayer is not performed over him; rather, he is buried in his clothes
Fourth: How to wash the dead
Fifth: Shrouding the dead

items.ar: سادسا: أحق الناس بغسله والصلاة عليه ودفنه: وصيه في ذلك، ثم الأب، ثم الجد، ثم الأقرب فالأقرب من العصبات في حق الرجل
items.tr: Sixth: the people most entitled to wash him, pray over him and bury him are: the one he appointed for that, then the father, then the grandfather, then the nearest and next nearest of the asabah (male relatives on the father's side), in the case of a man
Seventh: How to perform the funeral prayer
Eighth: How to bury the dead

items.ar: تاسعا: ويشرع لمن لم يُصَل عليه أن يصلي عليه بعد الدفن
items.tr: Ninth: it is prescribed for whoever did not pray over him to pray over him after the burial

items.ar: عاشرا: لا يجوز لأهل الميت أن يصنعوا طعاما للناس
items.tr: Tenth: it is not permissible for the family of the dead person to prepare food for people

items.ar: حادي عشر: لا يجوز للمرأة الإحداد على ميت أكثر من ثلاثة أيام إلا على زوجها فإنه يجب عليها أن تحد عليه أربعة أشهر وعشرا، إلا أن تكون حاملا فعلى وضع الحمل
items.tr: Eleventh: it is not permissible for a woman to observe ihdad (mourning) for a dead person for more than three days, except for her husband, for whom she must mourn four months and ten days, unless she is pregnant, in which case it is until she gives birth

items.ar: ثاني عشر: يشرع للرجال زيارة القبور بين وقت وآخر للدعاء لهم، والترحم عليهم، وتذكر الموت وما بعده
items.tr: Twelfth: it is prescribed for men to visit the graves from time to time to supplicate for them, ask mercy for them, and remember death and what comes after it

items.ar: يكبر أربعا، ويقرأ بعد الأولى: الفاتحة، وإن قرأ معها سورة قصيرة أو آية أو آيتين فحسن
items.tr: He says the takbir ('Allahu akbar') four times, and after the first he recites al-Fatihah; and if he recites with it a short surah, or a verse or two, that is good

items.ar: ثم يكبر الثانية ويصلي على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كصلاته في التشهد
items.tr: Then he says the second takbir ('Allahu akbar') and invokes blessings on the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, as he does in the tashahhud (the seated testimony)

items.ar: ثم يكبر الثالثة، ويقول: (اللهم اغفر لِحينا وميتِنا، وشاهدنا وغائبنا، وصغيرنا وكبيرنا، وذَكَرِنا وأنثانَا
items.tr: Then he says the third takbir ('Allahu akbar') and says: «اللهم اغفر لِحينا وميتِنا، وشاهدنا وغائبنا، وصغيرنا وكبيرنا، وذَكَرِنا وأنثانَا» [O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those of us present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females]

items.ar: ثم يكبر الرابعة، ويسلم تسليمة واحدة عن يمينه
items.tr: Then he says the fourth takbir ('Allahu akbar') and gives one taslim (closing greeting of peace) to his right
He says the takbir ('Allahu akbar') four times

items.ar: الدرس الثامن عشر تجهيز الميت والصلاة عليه
items.tr: Lesson Eighteen: Preparing the dead and praying over them
How to shroud the dead

items.ar: صُحِّح في هذه الصفحة حرفٌ في الحديث: «ففد» إلى «فقد»، كما في مجموع فتاوى ابن باز، ج٣ ص٢٩٠.
items.tr: One letter in the hadith was corrected on this page: «ففد» to «فقد», as in Majmu' Fatawa Ibn Baz, vol. 3, p. 290.
